candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot long-horizon metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: BDUK December 2025 and July 2026 values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag. They do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.long_horizon_metric: Long-horizon deltas, ratios, shares, gaps and classifications are deterministic calculations over displayed rounded values for comparable contract labels. Scope revisions and ingestion changes can drive movement; the metrics are not official statistics, forecasts, supplier-performance verdicts or parcel-level claims.
scope_guards.connected_scope: Connected Nations Spring 2026 figures are national availability and take-up estimates with a January 2026 reference date and stated methodology. They do not prove service availability, speed or orderability at an individual address.
scope_guards.planned_scope: Planned Network Deployments 2026 contains operator-stated, forward-looking plans and scenarios. Plans may not be realised and are not promises, exact-address forecasts or evidence of current availability.

documents.title: December 2025: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
July 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts

expansion_rule: For each of 36 contract rows common to December 2025 and July 2026 emit eighteen records: December supplier, December contracted, December built, July supplier continuity, July contracted, July built, contracted delta, built delta, built percentage change, December built ratio, July built ratio, ratio-point change, December unbuilt gap, July unbuilt gap, gap delta, December share of displayed built total, July share of displayed built total, and a long-horizon continuity classification. Append 32 Ofcom Connected Nations and planned-deployment records. Every fifth expanded record is REVALIDATION; all others are UPGRADE.
